groups.distinction: ErrorFilter and Error variants distinguish OOM, validation and internal causes; ErrorScopeGuard owns a dispatch device/index and explicit pop lifetime. ErrorSource retains native boxed error, distinct from Display description.
groups.uses: Device callback accepts Error; native source() returns its retained cause and Display emits selected presentation. Sampler/QuerySet handles denote resource kind, preventing handle substitution even without numeric validation.
groups.disposition: Keep native kind/cause/ownership and resource-handle distinctions. No redundant purpose wrapper proven. Application stage/context should wrap the existing cause where needed, not stringify or invent a second native error taxonomy.
groups.acceptance: Any later connected application error repair preserves native classification, source chain, device association, explicit scope completion and meaningful handler lifetime. No full unregistered guard pop body or GPU run credit.

groups.disposition: Keep native type-erasure and adapter distinctions. Caller formatting before msg loses an original typed error; actual application callers need independent11 review before alias/finding. No blanket assertion that anyhow erases all causes or that every wrapper needs numeric validation.
groups.acceptance: Connected application wrappers retain actual native source and contextual owner; avoid adding universal error/quantity framework or dependency source repair.

groups.uses: App returns optional fallback; FallbackErrorHandler default chooses match_severity and severity selects handler. Native Result alias defaults BevyError but permits explicit E, avoiding forced wider errors. ErrorContext kind() prose is logging output from variant, not branch authority.
groups.disposition: Keep native callback/resource, error/context and severity distinctions. Do not merge source classification with logging severity or require every context to carry last_run. Native deprecated DefaultErrorHandler alias is external framework compatibility evidence only; no application alias use or SDK repair authorized.
groups.acceptance: Application boundary may adapt exact native error and context while retaining cause. Default severity Panic is source-backed; no assertion that all handlers panic. No actual callback/observer execution or unregistered internal error body credit.

sources.qualification: Registered endpoint159 exceeds exactEOF129; every actual scoped line read, no nonexistent line credit.

groups.distinction: Typed AssetId<A> prevents asset-category substitution; UntypedAssetId keeps native runtime type information at heterogeneous dispatch. AssetPath, loader type, source error and wait state are different contracts even when some share string storage.
groups.uses: Failed internal event forwards path/error to both typed and untyped events; AssetLoaderError retains Arc<BevyError> with accessor. WaitForAssetError separates never-loaded from own failure and dependency failure with cause. AssetEvent loaded-with-dependencies differs Added/Modified/Unused identity history.
groups.disposition: Keep resource type/identity and source-versus-dependency failure distinctions. Presentation description and stable AssetPath are not interchangeable just because both serialize text. No extra enum merely renaming arbitrary asset indices; no redundant native wrappers proved.
groups.acceptance: Later actual application streaming/readiness graph must retain relevant identity, failure source and dependency classification through status; native event confirms cause availability, not that all application consumers preserve it. No asset load/hot reload run or whole server body credit.
